Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.

- Do not recommend a solution.

## Problem
Users are locked out of the Keelwater claims portal because they cannot reset their passwords. This prevents them from accessing critical documents and dashboards needed to serve policyholders.

## Who is affected
- Five accounts have reported this issue via support requests [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:1985bf360623f3e8][i:256d22f87c0754fe][i:479d6ae6d863104a][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- The affected accounts include Linnet House Insurance, Tidewell Marine & Cargo, Merrow Vale Motor, Brackwater Homecover, and Marrowgate Commercial [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:256d22f87c0754fe][i:479d6ae6d863104a][i:b5ce42913f135e93].

## Evidence
- There have been 7 mentions of this problem, all routed through support [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:1985bf360623f3e8][i:256d22f87c0754fe][i:479d6ae6d863104a][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the five affected accounts is £3,036,000.0 [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:256d22f87c0754fe][i:479d6ae6d863104a][i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- One of these accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- Users report being locked out and unable to access policyholder documents or the claims dashboard, stating I need to reset my password for the claims portal — can you guide me through it? [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49], I need to reset my password because I can’t access the documents section for policyholders. [i:0ad2bc981221b1c4], and I’m locked out of our claims portal and need to reset my password urgently. [i:256d22f87c0754fe].

## Why now
- The issue has been reported consistently from 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-25 [i:0aa5c1d7d2ff3a49][i:0ad2bc981221b1c4][i:1985bf360623f3e8][i:256d22f87c0754fe][i:479d6ae6d863104a][i:662c75b11af4fd54][i:b5ce42913f135e93].
- With one renewal occurring in the next 90 days, continued access issues could impact renewal risk for accounts representing significant ARR [i:b5ce42913f135e93].
</previous_draft>
